name: Straight slot, ramped
author: GlossCode
about: Mills a straight slot one tool wide from the start point to the end point. Each pass ramps down along the slot by STEP, then cuts back to the start at that depth. A last pass finishes at the end point. The top of the slot is Z0.

args.name: STX
args.desc: X at the start of the slot

args.name: STY
args.desc: Y at the start of the slot

args.name: ENX
args.desc: X at the end of the slot

args.name: ENY
args.desc: Y at the end of the slot

args.name: DEP
args.desc: Final depth (negative, Z0 is the top)

args.name: STEP
args.desc: How much deeper each pass goes

args.name: CLR
args.desc: Rapid to this height before and after

args.name: RAMP
args.desc: Feed for the ramp passes (defaults to half of FEED)
